plan.title: ¡Qué calor! · Practice plan
plan.description: Five days · 15–20 minutes per day · Start whenever you’re ready. Planned practice; completion not yet recorded.

days.title: Make flashcards
days.description: Start with 12–15 weather words and phrases. Put a Spanish phrase on one side and its meaning or a picture on the other.

days.title: Read a weather report
days.description: Review your cards, then read a short forecast in Spanish. Highlight familiar vocabulary and add up to five useful phrases.

days.title: Describe the weather
days.description: Use the report to write five sentences about today’s weather and tomorrow’s forecast. Read them aloud.

days.title: Watch a forecast
days.description: Choose a short Spanish forecast. Watch once for the general meaning, again with Spanish captions if available, and a third time to repeat useful phrases.

days.title: Give your own forecast
days.description: Record a 30–60-second weather report. Include today, tomorrow, a temperature, and a suggestion about clothing or activities.
